name: aproda-aldc
description: Aproda ALDC project tooling for Visual Studio Code.

languageModelTools.name: aprodaAldc_readConfiguration
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the authoritative aldc.yaml configuration for the current ALDC project. Use this before making a decision that depends on ALDC configuration, including the toolkit root, plans root, Aproda layer version, or BCQuality settings. It resolves the repository root from workspace folders, so it works when the repository root is not itself a workspace folder. It is read-only and returns a structured result. Do not use it for general source-code questions.

commands.title: Aproda ALDC: Apply Layer to Project
Aproda ALDC: Reset Layer Cache and Settings

aprodaAldc.devRoot.markdownDescription: Developer root used by future Aproda ALDC tooling, for example `I:/Florian Köll`.

aprodaAldc.source.mode.markdownDescription: Layer source mode. Use `managed` unless you maintain the Aproda layer.

aprodaAldc.source.forkPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local Aproda ALDC fork. Used only in `localFork` mode.

aprodaAldc.source.repositoryUrl.markdownDescription: Repository used by the managed layer cache.

aprodaAldc.pinnedVersion.markdownDescription: Layer version to use when the channel is `pinned`, for example `1.2.0_aproda.9`.

aprodaAldc.pwshPath.markdownDescription: PowerShell executable used by later project commands.

aprodaAldc.startupCheck.enabled.markdownDescription: Check for a newer Aproda ALDC layer when an AL project opens.

aprodaAldc.startupCheck.intervalHours.markdownDescription: Minimum time between automatic layer update checks.

scripts.package: npm run compile && node ./node_modules/@vscode/vsce/vsce package --out dist/aproda-aldc.vsix
scripts.test: npm run compile && node ./test/version-compare.test.js && node ./test/reset-data.test.js && node ./test/dev-root.test.js
